description: This Java class `DeleteGroupCommandHandler` handles the deletion of a group within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the `NewCommandSourceHandler` interface and is annotated with `@CommandType` specifying the 'GROUP' entity and 'DELETE' action. The class relies on the `GroupingTypesWritePlatformService` to perform the actual deletion when the `processCommand` method is invoked with a `JsonCommand` object.

classes.name: DeleteGroupCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles 'DELETE' commands for 'GROUP' entities, invoking the relevant service to delete a group based on the provided command.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to delete a group by calling the deleteGroup method of GroupingTypesWritePlatformService with the entity ID extracted from the command.
